add.value: message && message.match(/local set$/) ? 'set' : message && message.match(/local delete$/) ? 'delete' : 'other'

functions.description: Classify audit action (set/delete/other) from esxcli message

add.name: dest_ip

add.name: log_time

functions.description: Alias Copilot/schematizer OCSF-style fields to canonical names

add.name: _time
add.value: (typeof log_time != 'undefined' && log_time) ? (/^\d{13}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) * 1000 : /^\d{13}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ? Number(log_time) : /^\d{10}\.\d+$/.test(String(log_time)) ?
